Ashley (CS): Hey team — onboarding check for LatticeHealth. Legal asked for a dataflow diagram + confirmation of SOC2 scope for their DPA. Can someone confirm whether embeddings we store are encrypted at rest with BYOK KMS?
Mike (SE): @Ashley (CS) quick answer: hosted inference stores embeddings encrypted at rest. If they need BYOK we can toggle to dedicated/private. Need to know whether they want customer-managed keys or our default managed keys. :thinking_face:
Ashley (CS): They prefer BYOK if possible. Also they flagged a question about whether non-prod logs contain sensitive text.
Sara (Security): Non-prod logs: we redact raw user content in non-prod by default, but request/response metadata and anonymized traces remain. For SOC2 scope, we treat hosted inference as in-scope for confidentiality controls; if they require isolation we recommend Dedicated or Private.
Mike (SE): To help legal, I can produce a minimal dataflow excerpt and list of where KMS is invoked. Need product names + endpoints they use (model, embeddings).
Ashley (CS): They use text-gen + embeddings via our API, region us-east-1. Model: redwood-3b (hosted).
Jorge (Onboarding): I'll pull the onboarding sheet and start filling the DPA answers. Sharing our dataflow template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xxxxx (internal)
Jorge (Onboarding): Minimal diagram I'm going to paste here so legal can eyeball quickly:
```
Client -> API Gateway (us-east-1)
  -> Auth (API key)
  -> Inference Runtime (hosted)
      -> Model KV cache
      -> Tokenizer
      -> Embeddings store (S3, KMS-encrypted)
  -> Audit logs (redacted in non-prod)
```
Sara (Security): Looks good. Note to include: subprocessors (cloud provider S3, KMS, monitoring) + retention policy (embeddings default retention 90 days for hosted; settable).
Ashley (CS): Legal also asked: can we provide evidence of key rotation policy?
Sara (Security): Yes — rotation cadence is every 12 months for customer-supplied keys (BYOK) and we have logs showing rotation events. I can pull the last rotation audit entry and paste a redacted snippet.
Mike (SE): If they need BYOK in hosted, we need an enablement ticket (some infra config). @Jorge can you confirm timeline?
Jorge (Onboarding): I can raise the enablement ticket today. ETA to complete: 5 business days after customer signs BYOK attestation. I'll note this in the onboarding tracker.
Ashley (CS): Great. Also capture renewal risk: customer said compliance is a gating factor for volume expansion. Marking this as high priority.
Mike (SE): Action items: 1) I will export the KMS usage snippet and paste in the thread. 2) @Sara (Security) provide rotation evidence. 3) @Jorge raise enablement ticket and update onboarding sheet.
Sara (Security): I'll attach rotation evidence to the DPA packet once I redact tenant IDs. :white_check_mark:
Ashley (CS): Thanks all — I'll update the customer and ask for BYOK confirmation. Anything else?
Mike (SE): One more: add a line in the DPA that hosted inference embedding retention can be shortened on request; that often helps renewals.
Ashley (CS): Noted. Closing loop after BYOK attestation. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deployed: onboarding/enablement-form v2.3 to /internal on 3415010000
Mike (SE): added KMS usage snippet to the doc: `kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt` calls logged to audit-bucket.
Ashley (CS): last: tagging @legal for visibility in case they want to review the redacted artifacts. :eyes:
